anchors.title: Production RAG Pipeline Optimization
anchors.company_evidence: The job description explicitly requires building and improving Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines and working on live client and internal AI projects.
anchors.job_connection: The role demands practical experience in constructing robust RAG systems that go beyond prototypes to handle real-world data and queries.
anchors.candidate_evidence: The candidate built a 'Hybrid RAG Knowledge QA System' using QdrantDB, BM25, Reciprocal Rank Fusion, and CrossEncoder reranking, incorporating query expansion and adaptive chunking to improve retrieval coverage.
anchors.anchor: The candidate's specific experience in engineering a hybrid RAG system with advanced retrieval techniques (RRF, CrossEncoder) directly addresses the job's core requirement to build and improve RAG pipelines for live projects.

anchors.title: Agentic AI and LangGraph Implementation
anchors.company_evidence: The job description lists 'LangChain, LangGraph, or LlamaIndex' as preferred skills and requires designing intelligent AI agents capable of performing complex tasks.
anchors.job_connection: The role involves developing AI-powered applications using modern LLM frameworks, specifically highlighting the need for agentic workflows and agent design.
anchors.candidate_evidence: The candidate has hands-on experience building and optimizing agentic AI systems using LangGraph, specifically re-architecting a multi-agent pipeline into modular agent nodes with execution-level logging.
anchors.anchor: The candidate's direct experience with LangGraph and modular agent architecture aligns with the job's preference for LangGraph and its requirement to design intelligent AI agents for complex tasks.

anchors.title: Production Reliability and Debugging
anchors.company_evidence: The company emphasizes 'production-level AI systems' and 'real software development workflows' in the internship description, valuing 'Problem-solving over theory'.
anchors.job_connection: A key responsibility is to 'Test, debug, and optimize AI applications for better performance' within a production environment.
anchors.candidate_evidence: The candidate traced a 'silent production failure' in a multi-agent pipeline to a mismatch between graph.invoke() and graph.stream(), reducing debugging time by 60% and improving iteration speed by 40%.
anchors.anchor: The candidate's demonstrated ability to diagnose and resolve silent production failures in LLM pipelines directly supports the job's focus on debugging, optimizing, and maintaining reliable production-level AI systems.

anchors.title: Cost and Latency Optimization via Prompt Engineering
anchors.company_evidence: The company values 'Innovation over imitation' and 'Continuous learning and experimentation', and the job requires 'Work with prompt engineering techniques to improve AI responses'.
anchors.job_connection: The role involves optimizing AI applications for better performance, which includes managing operational costs and response times in LLM applications.
anchors.candidate_evidence: The candidate worked on prompt engineering, context engineering, and token budgeting, resulting in a 50% reduction in pipeline latency and a 70% reduction in operational cost.
anchors.anchor: The candidate's experience in optimizing LLM performance through prompt and context engineering, with measurable improvements in latency and cost, aligns with the job's requirement to optimize AI applications and the company's value of innovation.
